question: How many recursive calls are made when computing the sum of the vector {2, 4, 6, 8, 10} with listSum()?

answers.feedback: Incorrect. 6 is the total number of calls to listSumFrom(): the initial call listSumFrom(numList, 0) plus the recursive calls. The initial call is not itself a recursive call.

Correct! The initial call listSumFrom(numList, 0) makes 5 recursive calls, with index 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5. The last one sees index == numList.size(), the empty range, and returns 0 without recursing. That is 6 calls in total, 5 of them recursive.

Incorrect. That would be right only if a one-element range were the base case. In listSumFrom() the base case is the empty range (index == numList.size()), so the call for {10} still recurses once more.
Incorrect. Each recursive call advances index by one, so going from index 0 to index 5 (the empty range) takes 5 recursive calls.
